title: Our and your endings: -mme, -nne
summary: Attach -mme for our and -nne for your group ownership.
objectives: Attach -mme for our and -nne for your group ownership.
Apply this rule with the supporting forms shown.

sections.title: How the pattern works
paragraphs: A possessive ending is attached to the noun and identifies the owner. meidän uses -mme; teidän uses -nne.
pallo (“ball”) + -mme = pallomme (“our ball”). Keep both m letters in -mme and both n letters in -nne.
These tasks name one thing. Add the ending to the supplied basic noun. Do not remove the ending just because the owner pronoun is present.

commonMistakes: Keep the possessive ending when the owner pronoun is visible.
Changing the ending changes the owner, not the number of things.
